description:
A fast-feudal and fast paced build order for French players with good micro and macro. 

Play 1tc aggro with knights and 9 to 11 archers (to one-shot spearmen) and ram opponent if 2tc, hit them with age-up and upgrades if opponent plays FC.
name: French 3:38 Feudal All-in/Castle Timing
author: Valdemar1902

notes: All @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@ (pull @resource/sheep.png@close to TC & try to get 1 @resource/sheep.png@ back home to have 4 in total)
First @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build a @building_economy/house.png@ and then to @resource/sheep.png@
Shift click the 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ onto @resource/resource_wood.png@ where they will build @building_economy/house.png@@building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
Queue @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ non-stop and build an @building_military/archery-range.png@ when 150 @resource/resource_wood.png@

Add @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ for +1 @technology_military/iron-undermesh.png@ to dive villagers. Add @technology_military/siege-engineering.png@ to take out 2nd TC with 2 @unit_siege/battering-ram.png@ (usually enough)
Go castle age if opponent is going feudal aggro and you take a good fight or double down and all-in.
Go rams if your opponent goes 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Go Units into Castle timing if opponent goes fast @age/age_3.png@
This strat works against most civs but vs @civilization_flag/rus.webp@And @civilization_flag/chi.png@it is a lot more difficult and 2tc is more ideal.

description: A fast knight opener forcing spears from opponent into mass archer. Especially strong against infantry civs like English, Byzantines, Ottomans etc
name: 3:40 3 Knights & Mass Archer
author: Valdemar1902

notes: All @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/sheep.png@ (pull @resource/sheep.png@close to TC & try to get 1 @resource/sheep.png@ back home to have 4 in total)
First @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build a @building_economy/house.png@ and then to @resource/sheep.png@
Shift click the 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ onto @resource/resource_wood.png@ where they will build @building_economy/house.png@@building_economy/lumber-camp.png@
Queue a total of 3 @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ and build an @building_military/archery-range.png@ when 150 @resource/resource_wood.png@
@building_military/archery-range.webp@ and now macro according to if you need more knights or archers.

description: A build to quickly get Pro Scouts and then transition into units.
name: Fast Pro Scouts
author: Valdemar1902

notes: Drop off all resources and start construction with 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.png@
Play it out now with aggression and force farms by denying deer. You can eventually go castle as well as you will have a lot of food, but there is rarely a need for that

description:
Based on Beasty's guide.

Fight in Feudal.
Leave room in between your production building to add a keep later in the game.

Keep villagers safe on the map to get further ahead.
Groups of 5 villagers per resource.
Build Outpost next to resources.

Semantics:
Villagers count is target after following all steps in the description.
Time is start trigger per step and can be used as a benchmark.
name: FRE | 2TC | Feudal Pressure | School of Cavalry
author: exe

notes: @age/age_3.png@@landmark_french/royal-institute.png@@technology_french/royal-bloodlines.png@to end the game or@landmark_french/guild-hall.png@to prepare for lategame
Train @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ and pressure for idle time
Continue to make units non stop. Mostly @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@
Age up to age 3 at min 12 with 10 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @landmark_french/guild-hall.webp@

Get upgrades on units and @unit_religious/monk-3.webp@ for @resource/relics.webp@. Put 3-6 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ for a @building_defensive/keep.webp@ to reduce production costs.
As soon as @building_economy/mill.webp@ is done research @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@

@unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ + @technology_economy/specialized-pick.webp@, research @technology_economy/horticulture.webp@ or@technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ as soon as possible and eventually @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@, @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@

Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ or @building_military/stable.webp@ depending on situation. Maintain 8-10 vils on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if you are going full @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@, else switch to wood to produce @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@

description:
The First AGGRESSIVE Build You Should Learn by Swaggy Professor.

Made to be compatible with Overlay.
name: The First AGGRESSIVE Build You Should Learn - Swaggy Professor
author: Niki45nk

notes: Find at least 2 @resource/sheep.webp@ with @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ and send back to @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Make sure to scout enemy base for exposed @unit_worker/villager.webp@
Always make @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ at @landmark_french/school-of-cavalry.webp@ and send to harass enemy @unit_worker/villager.webp@
If your opponent also has Cavalry, build @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ near @resource/resource_gold.webp@
If your opponent has many @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@, build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and make @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@
Now, continue making @unit_french/royal-knight-2.webp@ and @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ to attack your opponent
When you want to Age-Up transfer all @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/resource_gold.webp@
When you have 900 @resource/resource_stone.webp@, all @resource/resource_stone.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @building_defensive/keep.webp@ around your Military buildings
